config.teacher_history: FEN only, no earlier move stack
config.value_target: tanh(side-to-move centipawns / 600); mate score represented as signed 10000 cp
config.data_split: Disjoint generated game IDs; global exact state dedup ignores halfmove/fullmove counters
config.topology: Synthetic signed 16 sensory/24 inter/16 command/8 motor circuit, 352 edges
config.control: 20000 double-edge-swap proposals preserve each node signed in/out degrees
config.observation: Numeric FEN pieces, side, castling, EP and counters; no teacher scores or history input
config.loss: Final-depth legal-masked move cross entropy plus 0.5 bounded-value MSE
config.evaluation: All final checkpoints on the same 1024 generated development positions
config.selection: No early stopping, checkpoint selection, retries, replacements or budget extension
config.claim_scope: Initial supervised chess distillation baseline, not RL, Elo, novelty or imported biology

continuation_gate.scope: Descriptive development gate to consider a larger study, not efficacy or publication evidence
